title: Good but Severely Lacking Basic Functions
body:
Its ok but there are entire UI elements which essentially serve zero purpose. It asks how many time you want to a habit in how much time (3 times per 5 days for example) but then this serves no function. You still only get one “tick box” and it becomes your responsibility to do the actual tracking. You are expected to track the three times yourself then come check it off once its 100% done. As a result its only really works for habits which are once per day thing. Suppose that’s what the journal is for but why not just make it part of the UI like almost literally every other habit app?

It also has no stats tracking long term beyond showing what days were completed. Opening up a habit will show a basic calendar with completed days ticked off. Theres no tracking beyond that which isnt a huge deal for me honestly but would be nice. 

I get this app is trying to be “simple and easy” but in aiming for that you’ve forgotten to add some very basic functionality.

body: The app is great, definitely #2 behind Emphasis (which I don’t use anymore because they added a paywall), however there are two problems I have that prevent it from being #1. This is a problem because every couple minutes, my phone screen turns off which distracts me from my work as I have to constantly keep turning it back on which slows down my work flow. The second problem I have is that the app doesn’t make sound when my phone’s ringer is off. I keep my ringer off (to prevent getting distracted) so when the timer is up, my phone doesn’t make a sound. Apart from those two features, the app is amazing to use. One other feature that I would suggest adding is to make it so the timer is adjustable, however the first two points are much more important in my opinion. Thanks for making an amazing app!

title: Great app, simple and free. Could use some features
body:
The app is really sleek, the design is minimalistic just as I like, your screen isn’t cluttered. It’s easy to navigate, there isn’t too much going on - it has one job and it does it effectively. They also include a focus/break timer, which is a nice touch.
 
To developers, my 2 cents: 

Reminder notifications shouldn’t be necessary to create a habit. It should be optional. Why?

You should not be forced to allocate a specific day of the week to a task. There are some tasks that I just do occasionally and I just want to be able to track that I’ve done it, not set a specific day for it. 

There’s already a setting for “I want to do this X times in Y days”. That’s more than enough, you guys should leave it at that. 

Not to mention, if someone wants to track a private habit, they might not want a notification popping up on their screen for people to potentially see. You should be able to set reminders for some habits and turn them off for others.

Other than that, great app, and much more effective than many other paid apps on the store. Keep it up.

title: Great App. Missing only minor things
body:
The app is exactly what we’re looking for - minus some small things that would be great!

First of all the option to track units when marking a habit completed would be an awesome addition, having a view of progression definitely contributes a key part of habit forming. 

The UX in the habit creation screen also appears to be slightly unintuitive where you lose what you entered in the field if you switch to another element in the form. Ideally it would set the state of the field on change versus on “Confirm”.

Lastly, it would be great to have some sort of Siri Shortcut integration for marking habits as completed, this would make tracking things like exercise much more useful. 

Just my two sense, thank you for the fantastic app.

Cheers!
